description: Find veterinary clinics near a location. Use when the user asks for a vet near me, the best or highest-rated vets in an area, a vet open now, an animal hospital nearby, or a vet for routine or non-urgent care. Returns each clinic's name, address, distance, star rating, open-now status, and phone number. Read-only: it only searches public listings and cannot book appointments, place orders, or change anything.

keywords.description: Extra keywords to narrow the search, e.g. 'cat', 'exotic pets', 'low cost'. Optional.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1-10. Default 5.

location.description: Where to search: a city, address, ZIP code, or 'latitude,longitude'.

min_rating.description: Minimum star rating from 1 to 5, e.g. 4.0. Optional.

open_now.description: If true, only return clinics that are currently open.

pet.description: Optional pet info. Species changes which clinics are searched (e.g. horse searches equine vets). Breed and name are display-only and are never stored.

breed.description: Breed, e.g. 'King Charles Cavalier'. Optional, display only.

name.description: Pet's name. Optional, display only, never stored.

species.description: One of: dog, cat, horse, bird, reptile, small_mammal, other.

name: find_vets
